Company Description

👋🏼 We're Nagarro. We are a digital product engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at scale — across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world, with 18,000+ experts across 39 countries. Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical, empowering our people to take ownership, collaborate openly, and create meaningful impact.

Job Description

We are looking for a highly skilled and proactive Windows Administrator to support and manage our enterprise infrastructure across both on-premises and cloud environments. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the stability, security, and performance of Windows-based systems, datacenter operations, virtualization platforms, and Azure cloud services. The ideal candidate brings hands-on expertise in Windows Server administration, monitoring, storage, and backup solutions, along with a strong commitment to operational excellence. Experience with Linux administration is a plus.

  • Install, configure, administer, and maintain Windows Server operating systems (Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 or later), including DNS, DHCP, File and Print Services, and Windows Failover Clustering.
  • Perform routine datacenter operations, including server provisioning, hardware troubleshooting, firmware updates, patch management, and lifecycle management.
  • Administer virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere (ESXi/vCenter) and Microsoft Hyper-V.
  • Deploy, configure, and manage workloads in Microsoft Azure, including Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Storage, Backup, and Azure Active Directory.
  • Monitor infrastructure health, performance, and availability using monitoring tools such as SolarWinds, PRTG, or equivalent.
  • Configure and manage enterprise backup and recovery solutions, including Veeam Backup & Replication, and ensure high availability and disaster recovery readiness.
  • Administer storage technologies, including SAN/NAS environments, storage provisioning, and capacity management.
  • Troubleshoot server, virtualization, storage, networking, and operating system issues, and perform security hardening.
  • Maintain system documentation, operational procedures, and asset inventory.
  • Participate in on-call support and respond to production incidents as required.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience in Windows Server administration and enterprise infrastructure support.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows Server environments, Active Directory, virtualization technologies, storage systems, and backup solutions.
  • Experience supporting hybrid infrastructure environments, including on-premises datacenters and Microsoft Azure.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively document procedures, incidents, and technical solutions.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced setting.
  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality IT services and support.
  • Service Region: Eastern Europe
